items.explanation: PostgreSQL shorthand for CAST(expr AS type).
items.example: SELECT '42'::int + 1 AS n, order_date::text FROM orders LIMIT 1;
items.expected: One row: 43 and a date string.

items.syntax: SELECT DISTINCT ON (k) … ORDER BY k, col DESC
items.explanation: Keeps the first row of each k after sorting (PostgreSQL-only).
items.example: SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id) customer_id, order_id, order_date FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id, order_date DESC;

items.explanation: Returns the affected rows without a second query.
items.example: UPDATE products SET unit_price = unit_price * 1.1 WHERE category_id = 1 RETURNING product_id, unit_price;

items.syntax: INSERT … ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET col = EXCLUDED.col
items.explanation: Inserts or updates on unique-key conflict.
items.example: INSERT INTO shippers (shipper_id, company_name) VALUES (1, 'Renamed') ON CONFLICT (shipper_id) DO UPDATE SET company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name RETURNING *;

items.explanation: Set-returning function for sequences and calendars.
items.example: SELECT n FROM generate_series(1, 5) AS n;

items.syntax: FROM a CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT … WHERE b.k = a.k LIMIT n)
items.explanation: A LATERAL subquery can reference earlier FROM items.
items.example: SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name FROM categories c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT product_name FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1) p;

items.explanation: Collects values into an array; unnest() reverses it.
items.example: SELECT category_id, ARRAY_AGG(product_id ORDER BY product_id) AS ids FROM products GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY category_id;
items.expected: Array of product ids per category.

items.explanation: Produce JSON documents directly in SQL.
items.example: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', shipper_id, 'name', company_name) AS doc FROM shippers;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE discontinued) AS discontinued, COUNT(*) AS total FROM products;
items.expected: One row: discontinued and total products.

items.example: SELECT company_name FROM suppliers WHERE company_name ILIKE '%ltd%';
